goal: Finish the espansoConfig editing app per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §12, phase by phase with a review gate on every one.

phases.title: Fidelity spike and architectural gate
phases.summary: Parser substrate chosen, syntax index, scalar codec, patch engine and four edit operations; the round-trip gate passed over both corpora.

phases.title: Read-only browser
phases.summary: Core read model, Tauri shell, i18n layer and the three-pane browser; the owner's whole real config renders in a window.

phases.title: The save transaction in Rust
phases.summary: The whole save transaction with lock, revision check, reparse, acknowledgement and backup, built with no caller.

phases.title: The writing commands
phases.summary: Eleven Tauri commands, five of them writers, every writer ending in one run_one_save.

phases.title: The editing UI
phases.summary: Ten sub-phases: the raw and small editors, create, delete, move, duplicate, conflict capture, reapply, recovery and restore from backup.
